title: RepoHyper: Search-Expand-Refine on Semantic Graphs for Repository-Level Code Completion

key_numbers.metric: Context retrieval acc@3, RepoBench-R Easy/Hard (RepoHyper+UniXcoder vs UniXcoder baseline)
End-to-end EM/CodeBLEU, RepoBench-P XF-F (RepoHyper-L2H+GPT-3.5 vs RepoCoder)

stop_detail: A Repo-level Semantic Graph (function/class/script nodes with import/invoke/ownership/hierarchy edges) is searched via kNN-seeded BFS graph expansion, then re-ranked by a GraphSAGE link-prediction model before insertion into the prompt (Section 4.3).

title: GraphCoder: Enhancing Repository-Level Code Completion via Code Context Graph-based Retrieval and Language Model

key_numbers.metric: Code EM gain vs RepoCoder (API-level, avg)

stop_detail: Query and candidate statements are converted into a Code Context Graph (control-flow, data-dependence, control-dependence edges from AST-based static analysis); candidates are Jaccard-filtered then re-ranked by decay-weighted subgraph edit distance to the query graph (Section 4.3).

title: M2rc-Eval: Massively Multilingual Repository-level Code Completion Evaluation

key_numbers.value: 18 languages, 100 val / 500 test samples per language, 5,993 test repos

stop_detail: Cross-file context is built by extracting L-line segments from same-repo files, ranking by Jaccard similarity to the in-file context, and concatenating top matches until a 4096-token cap (retrieval setting description).

stop_detail: Sec. 3.1: masking replaces environment observations older than a fixed window of M turns with a placeholder, while LLM-Summary replaces older turns beyond N+M turns with a periodically regenerated LLM-produced running summary plus a few recent turns in full (Eq. 3-6).

title: When Retrieval Hurts Code Completion: A Diagnostic Study of Stale Repository Context

key_numbers.metric: stale-reference rate increase, Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct (stale-only vs current-only)
stale-reference rate increase, gpt-4.1-mini (stale-only vs current-only)
stale-reference rate under mixed current/stale retrieval

stop_detail: A diagnostic harness manually substitutes current- vs. stale- (parent-commit) repository helper-function signatures as 'retrieved' context under five conditions (current-only, stale-only, no-retrieval, two mixed orders) to isolate whether stale retrieved context actively induces incompatible completions rather than acting as harmless noise (Methods).

title: Antaeus: Hunting Repository-Level Logic Vulnerabilities via Context-Grounded LLM Reasoning

key_numbers.metric: True positives detected, AntaeusO4.7 vs. best baselines
Cost per confirmed vulnerability, Antaeus vs. agentic baseline

stop_detail: A lightweight prioritization stage reduces the repository to a ranked set of security-relevant functions (keyword heuristics plus agentic LLM ranking of compressed signature+callee summaries), then each retained function is grounded with depth-one callee bodies and a repository-wide security summary (system purpose, trust topology) before structured sink/safety-condition LLM reasoning and comparative validation (Sec. III-A, III-B).

title: SWE-Pruner Pro: The Coder LLM Already Knows What to Prune
stop_detail: Reuses the agent's own frozen-backbone token representations produced during normal prefill of a tool response, feeding them through a lightweight length-aware classification head (LayerNorm + Linear-GELU-Dropout blocks) to assign each line a keep/prune label via majority vote of token-level decisions, pruning it before the next turn's context (Sec. 3.1-3.2).

title: Paritok-4B: Intent-Conditioned Context Compression for Coding Agents

key_numbers.metric: compression ratio vs quality retained (Paritok-4B, line-numbered input)

key_numbers.value: 96.0% (96.2% held-out) of emitted tokens present in input

stop_detail: A 4B LoRA adapter over Qwen3-4B, conditioned on the agent's current task intent, extractively selects spans (replacing dropped content with closed-vocabulary structural markers like '[body: N lines]') from each trajectory segment (file reads, bash output, edits) before it re-enters the coding agent's context (Sections 3-4, per-segment distillation pipeline).
